name: Example HVAC HKESim Project
description: Interactive hydraulic simulation example with HKESim backend. IFC path should be updated to match your local repository location.
notes: Based on examples/e1_simple_project_hvac_hkesim.py. Uses the same IFC as the AixLib simple example, but with group_unidentified set to 'name' instead of 'name_and_description'. The weather_file_path is relative to the bim2sim package root and resolved automatically.
